features: Audio over IP: 4 inputs (1 per IP camera)
Alarm inputs: IP camera dependent (no local input)
notes: VT-TNR414P(2) has its own product page and spec sheet with the same channel, PoE and bay counts.
HDD capacity: VT-TNR414P spec sheet 8TB, VT-TNR414P(2) spec sheet 10TB, product page bullets 6TB, product page specification table 10TB. Per-bay capacity left out.
Spec sheets and specification table give 50Mbps incoming / 50Mbps outgoing; the product page configuration listing gives 40Mbps. Bandwidth left out.
Spec sheets give power consumption of 5W or less without HDD; the VT-TNR414P product page gives less than 4W. Consumption left out.
Aliases: VT-TNR414P(2) plus the HDD-capacity configurations listed on the VT-TNR414P product page.
